- Insulin therapy to lower the blood glucose level
- Electrolyte monitoring and replacement as needed
- Close monitoring of the patient's vital signs and clinical status

The patient will also need to be evaluated for any underlying factors that may have contributed to the development of DKA, such as medication non-compliance, infection, or other comorbidities.
